lead: A `.nvs` proof program that opens a database needs its own `[[app]]` grant in the root `nvs.toml`, and a grant naming a file not yet on disk breaks every other program in the tree.
body: `db.connect` is granted per entry path, and a block whose `entry` names a missing path fails every `nvs run` with `E0605` about that path rather than about the program asked for. Write the grant and the file in one edit, copying the `Db-Row` group in `nvs.toml`: one block per example, per attack and per bench.
